item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00175","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C13","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C14 is a direct drafting template for the child. Both orders use essentially identical language to designate public international organizations under the International Organizations Immunities Act, preserve independently acquired privileges and immunities, and identify the order as supplementing the same cumulative series of prior directives. The child adapts C14 chiefly by substituting two newly designated organizations and adding C14 itself to the supplemental-order chain. C13 and C12 have limited incidental similarities but do not approach this concrete textual correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I hereby designate such organizations as public international organizations entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act","parent_excerpt":"I hereby designate such organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said Act.","explanation":"The child's central operative designation closely reproduces C14's language, adjusted from one organization to multiple organizations."},{"child_excerpt":"The designation of the above-named organizations ... is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organizations may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or Congressional action.","parent_excerpt":"The designation of the above-named organization ... is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or Congressional action.","explanation":"This distinctive savings clause is reproduced nearly verbatim, with only singular-to-plural changes."},{"child_excerpt":"This order supplements [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 19, 1946, 9751 of July 11, 1946, 9823 of January 24, 1947, 9863 of May 31, 1947, 9887 of August 22, 1947, 9911 of December 19, 1947, and 9972 of June 25, 1948.","parent_excerpt":"This order supplements [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 19, 1946, No. 9751 of July 11, 1946, No. 9823 of January 24, 1947, No. 9863 of May 31, 1947, No. 9887 of August 22, 1947, and No. 9911 of December 19, 1947.","explanation":"The child carries forward C14's exact cumulative supplementation sequence and appends C14's June 25, 1948 directive as the newest predecessor."}]}
